Resolve v4 → v4-next merge conflicts. A conflict analysis gist is at {{GIST_URL}}.

Steps:
1. Checkout v4-next: git checkout v4-next
2. Merge v4: git merge origin/v4 (this will produce conflicts)
3. Resolve each conflicted file. v4-next is authoritative for structural changes; port v4 bugfixes/features into the v4-next code structure.
4. Verify the build compiles (at minimum: cd yarn-project && yarn build)
5. Create a PR targeting v4-next with the resolved merge.

Use the conflict-details.diff file in the gist to see exactly what git produced.
Do NOT create a PR with unresolved conflict markers.
